book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn LUK

content: Ipwidien Sises
Ni ahnsowo Nanmwarki Sihsar Akustus ketin padokada kosonned ehu me ketihtihki tohn sapwellime wehi koaros en ntingdi.
Ih keieun ntingdien aramas met me wiawi ni mwehin Kirinius, kepinahn Siria.
Aramas koaros eri mwekidlahng nan uhdahn wasa me re ipwidi ie pwe re en iang ntingdi.
Sosep, pwehki eh kisehn kadaudok en Depit, e ahpw pil iang mwesel sang Kalili nan kisin kahnimw en Nasaret, kolahng Sudia nan kisin kahnimw en Depit, ede Pedleem,
pwe en iang ntingdi ie, iangahki Mery me e kisinihniong oh me liseian ahnsowo.
Ni ara ketiketier Pedleem, en Mery eh ahnsou ahpw lelehr pwe en neitik.
Ih eri ketin kaipwihedi sapwellime mesenih kisin pwutak kis. E ahpw ketin kidimkipene likoun seri oh ketikihdiong nan dewen kamwenge mahn ehu—pwehki eh sohla wasa nan imwen keiru.
Silepen Sihpw kei oh Tohnleng kei
Silepen sihpw kei wie sinsile nair pelin sihpw kan nipwongo nan sahpwo.
A tohnleng en Kaun-o men pa pwarodohng irail, oh marain en Koht dakerirailda oh kapilirailpene. Irail eri salohkihda kowahlap.
A tohnlengo ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail dehr masak, pwe I wadohng kumwail rohng kaperen mehlel pwoat, me pahn kaparanda aramas koaros.
Pwe pwongpwong wet Sounkomouro ipwidiongkumwailehr nan kahnimw en Depit—iei Kaun Mesaia!
Eri, iet kilelpe ong kumwail: kumwail pahn diar kisin seri pwelel kis me kidikidki likoun seri oh wonohn nan dewen kamwenge mahn.”
Ni ahnsowohte karis ehu en tohnleng ngedehrie pa pwarada wasao iang tohnlengo kapikapinga Koht, kokoulki:

content.text: oh mwehi kapohl nin sampah ong aramas akan me e kin ketin kupwuramwahwih!”

content: Ni tohnleng ko ar ketiketla sang irail oh ketiketla nanleng, silepe ko ndapene nanpwungarail, “Nna, kitail kolahng mahs Pedleem pwe kitail en kadehde dahme wiawihier wasao, me Kaun-o ahpwtehn mahsanihong kitail.”
Irail eri mwadangalahng Pedleem oh diarada Mery oh Sosep oh pil seri pwelelo me wonohn nan dewen kamwenge mahn.
Ni silepe ko ar kilangada kisin serio, re ahpw padahkihong Sosep oh Mery dahme tohnlengo mahsanihong irail duwen serio.
Oh koaros me rongorong silepe ko ahpw inenen pwuriamweikihla audepen ar koasoi ko.
Mery ahpw kin ketin tamataman mepwukat koaros oh kin ketin medemedewe nan kupwure.
Silepe ko eri pwuralahng nan arail wasa, sohte tokedi sang ar kapikapinga Koht pwehki mehkoaros me re rongehr oh kilangehr; pwe mehkoaros pweidahr duwen me tohnlengo mahsanihong irail.
Sises ketin Ale Mware
Mwurin wihk ehu, serio ahpw sirkumwsaisla; re ahpw kihong mware, Sises, duwen me tohnlengo ketikihongehr mwohn ine eh saikinte ahpada.
Kasarawihpen Sises
Ahnsoun kamwakel me ntingdier nan Kosonned en Moses lao daulih, Sosep oh Mery ahpw ketikidalahng serio Serusalem pwe en kasarawihong Kaun-o,
duwen me koasoandihsangehr rehn Kaun-o: “Seri wol koaros me mesenih pahn kin kasarawihong Kaun-o.”
Ira pil ketiki kohdahla ara mehn meirong, duwen me pil koasoandihsangehr rehn Kaun-o: eri, mwuroi riemen de mwuroi pwulopwul riemen.
Ni ahnsowo ohl emen kin mihmi Serusalem, mware Simion. Ohl menet inenen poadidi oh kin lemmwiki Koht; oh e kin iang kasikasik komourpen Israel, oh Ngehn Sarawi kin ketiket reh.
Ngehn Sarawi ketin kamarainihekihda me e sohte pahn mehla mwohn eh pahn udiahl Mesaia me Kaun-o ketin inoukidahr.
Ngehnohte pil kahluwahki Simion en pwaralahng nan Tehnpas Sarawio. Ni semen serio oh ine ara ketikihlong Sises nan Tehnpas Sarawio pwe en kapwaiada mahsen en Kosonnedo,
Simion alehte serio, pwekada oh kapikapinga Koht, patopatohwan,

content.text: “Maing ei Kaun, komw ketin mweidala sapwellimomwi ladu
en patopatohwei ni popohl, duwen me komw ketin inoukidahr.
Pwe pwoaren mesei kat kilangehr sapwellimomwi komour,
me komw ketin onopadahr mwohn mesen wehi koaros:
Marain ehu mehn kamarainih me rotorot akan
oh kalinganahla tohn sapwellimomwi wehi, Israel.”

content: Semen serio oh ine ahpw pwuriamweikihla mehkan me Simion koasoakoasoia duwen neira serio.

Simion kupwuramwahwih ira oh kohpadahng Mery, patohwan, “Kisin seri menet pilipildahr pwe en wiahla mehn meninkau oh mehn komour en me tohto rehn mehn Israel kan; e pahn wiahla kilel ehu me aramas tohto pahn pelianda,
oh kasalehkihda lamalam rir en nan kapehdirail kan. Oh nsensuwed laud pahn kauwehla kupwuromwien, rasehng kedlahs keng pwoat.”
Pil mie lih soukohp men, mware Ana, nein Panuel, kisehn kadaudok en Aser. E likeilapalahr oh sounparte isuh me eh pwoudo mihmihki reh,
pwe met e liohdilahr oh sounparehr 84. E sohte kin pedoisang nan Tehnpas Sarawio; pwe nipwong nin rahn e kin kaudokiong Koht, wie kapakap, oh kaisihsol.
Ni ahnsowohte e lella mwo oh kapingakalahngan en Koht oh koasoia duwen kisin serio ong irail koaros me awiawihodo komourpen Serusalem.
Irail Sapahllahng Nasaret
Ni arail kapwaiadahr mehkoaros me kileldier nan pelien kosonned en Kaun-o, re ahpw ketin sapahllahng Kalili, nan kisin kahnimw en Nasaret.
Serio eri kekeirda oh rosorosonla; e ahpw pil kupwukupwurokongla mehlel oh kalahngan en Koht kin sansalda reh.
Sises Nanpwungen Sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kan
Nan pahr koaros semen Sises oh ine kin ketidahla Serusalem pwe ira en iang Sarawien Pahsohpa.
Ni Sises eh mahkier sounpar eisek riau, re ahpw ketidahla pwe re en iang sarawio nin duwen ahnepahr.
Ni Sarawien Pahsohpao eh imwisekla, irail ahpw sapahllahng nan uhdakarail; a Sises ketikette Serusalem. Seme oh ine ahpw sasairki me e sohte ketin iang ira.
Ira patohwan lemeleme me e iangehr pokono tiengla mwohra. Mwurin ara seiseiloangki rahn ehu pwon, ira ahpw tapihada rapahki neira serio rehn seura oh kisehra kan.
Ni ara sohte diar, ira ahpw pwuralahng Serusalem raparapahkiseli ie.
Kedekedeo, mwurin rahn siluh ira ahpw diarada nan Tehnpas Sarawio, ni eh ketiket nanpwungen sounkawehwe ko, karokaronge irail oh kekeinemwe rehrail.
A koaros me iang rongorong inenen pwuriamweikihla sapwellime kupwurokong me pwarada ni sapwellime pasapeng kan.
Ni seme oh ine ara diarada, ira inenen pwuriamweikihla. Ineo eri patohwanohng, “Lao, dahme komw wiahkihong kiht met? Ngehi oh semomwiet inenen tihwohkihla at raparapahkinkomwiseli.”
A e ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Dahme kumwa raparapahkiniehki? Kumwa sohte ese me I uhdahn pahn kin mihmi nan tehnpas en Semei?”
Ira ahpw sohte patohwan wehwehki mahsen pwoatet.
Sises eri ketin iang ira ketiketlahng Nasaret, wasa e kin ketin peikiong ira. Ineo ahpw kin tamataman mepwukat koaros oh medemedewe.
Sises eri ketin kekeirda oh kupwurokongla, oh ketin masamasala mwohn Koht oh aramas akan.
